druid.name: Druid
druid.path: Feral-style solo leveling, with forms and utility checked at launch
druid.roles: DPS · tank or heal when equipped and comfortable
druid.early: Use efficient caster pulls until forms change your rhythm. Complete form quests promptly and carry water for caster-heavy levels.
druid.mid: Let travel and combat forms reduce downtime. Use stealth to bypass low-value fights and keep a healing set if you volunteer to heal.
druid.late: Choose a clear solo form/talent plan, but keep roots, heals, dispels and battle resurrection accessible. Verify Forever talent milestones.
pull: Open at range when it improves positioning.
Shift into the form suited to the fight and spend resources before they cap.
Use roots or travel tools to reset unsafe pulls.
Heal between fights in the cheaper form when practical.
druid.gear: Prioritize the stats and weapon-as-stat-stick value used by your chosen form; keep Intellect/healing pieces separately.
druid.dungeon: DPS by default. Tank or heal only with an appropriate set and a group that knows your spec.
druid.pvp: Use forms to break movement effects where supported, preserve mana for shifting, and exploit racial movement tools.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.early: Reach pet training and tame a practical companion. Keep ammunition, food and ranged weapon skill current.
hunter.mid: Let the pet establish threat before full damage. Practice safe pulls, pet control and line-of-sight rather than relying on accidental multi-pulls.
hunter.late: Maintain pet skills and happiness, carry ammunition and use traps or utility to control dangerous adds. Verify Forever talent and dead-zone changes.
pull: Send the pet and allow threat to build.
Apply only effects that will last long enough to pay off.
Maintain ranged distance and use melee tools only when forced.
Mend, feed and reposition the pet before the next dangerous pull.
hunter.gear: Ranged weapon damage is a major priority; compare Agility, attack power, critical chance and enough Stamina for PvP.
hunter.dungeon: Ranged DPS. Control pet movement and growl, avoid body pulls, and confirm traps or kiting with the tank.
hunter.pvp: Track opponents, protect ranged distance and save movement control for players who reach you.

mage.name: Mage
mage.path: Frost/control-oriented solo leveling unless launch tuning favors another tree
mage.early: Use a mana-efficient bolt-and-wand rhythm. Conjure food and water, train utility and avoid ambitious AoE before you can control it.
mage.mid: Frost control supports safe solo pulls; AoE only where respawns, terrain and PvP pressure allow it. Teleports can cut dungeon travel sharply.
mage.late: Balance damage with mana per kill. Keep polymorph, decurse, interrupts and escape tools accessible in groups.
pull: Open at maximum useful range.
Slow or control the target before it reaches you.
Use a wand or cheap finish when another full cast wastes mana.
Reset with control and movement instead of standing in melee.
mage.gear: Spell damage, Intellect and enough Stamina are useful; Spirit and wand quality matter more early than late.
mage.dungeon: Ranged DPS with Polymorph, interrupts, decurse and water. Never break agreed crowd control.
mage.pvp: Keep escape tools available, avoid casting from predictable open ground, and use anti-control racials at meaningful moments.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.path: Retribution-style solo leveling with strong support utility
paladin.roles: DPS · heal, or tank if Forever talents and gear support it
paladin.early: Keep a strong weapon and use seals and judgements efficiently. Healing reduces food downtime, but excessive spell use increases drinking.
paladin.mid: Plan blessings and auras for the activity. Carry an Intellect and healing set if you want faster dungeon groups.
paladin.late: Verify Forever’s tanking tools and talent changes before promising a role. Use cleanses, blessings and emergency protection proactively.
pull: Choose the correct seal and blessing before combat.
Judge when the target will live long enough to justify the mana.
Maintain weapon swings and avoid clipping them with unnecessary movement.
Heal before resources become an emergency.
paladin.gear: Weapon damage drives solo pace; Strength, critical chance and Stamina support damage, while Intellect and healing gear enable healing.
paladin.dungeon: DPS by default; healing is often viable with a set. Tank only after confirming your toolkit and telling the group.
paladin.pvp: Save defensive immunities and stun for decisive moments; cleanse allies and avoid exhausting mana on low-value damage.

priest.name: Priest
priest.early: Obtain an affordable wand. Apply Shadow Word: Pain only when it will tick enough, and use wand finishes to preserve mana.
priest.mid: Use Mind Flay and Shadow tools when they improve kills per drink. Spirit Tap and wand or talent values must be checked against current Forever ranks.
priest.late: Review the launch tree around Shadowform. Keep heals, dispels, Shackle and defensive abilities accessible even while leveling Shadow.
pull: Open at range and apply Pain when the target will survive enough ticks.
Spend only enough mana to reach a safe wand-finishing range.
Preserve fear for clear ground or an emergency.
Secure your own killing blow when Spirit Tap requires it, then recover while moving.
priest.gear: Prioritize a strong wand early, then useful spell damage, Intellect, Spirit and enough Stamina. Keep healing pieces.
priest.dungeon: Shadow DPS first; heal occasionally with water and an appropriate set. Do not rely on Spirit Tap for group-healing mana.
priest.pvp: Keep mana for shield, fear and emergency healing. Racial tools change how you answer control.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.path: Weapon-focused solo leveling with stealth and control
rogue.early: Keep both weapons current and train weapon skills. Use stealth to choose fights; do not turn every bypassed enemy into lost time.
rogue.mid: Maintain poisons and consumable reagents. Open with the control or damage tool suited to the target, and use interrupts aggressively.
rogue.late: Weapon upgrades and hit reliability matter. Keep Sap, Kick, stuns, vanish and threat control ready for dungeons and PvP.
pull: Approach in stealth when the opener saves time or risk.
Build and spend combo points before the target dies with unused resources.
Interrupt dangerous casts.
Vanish or sprint early enough to reset a losing pull.
rogue.gear: Main-hand damage and speed interaction matter; compare Agility, attack power, hit or critical chance and Stamina.
rogue.dungeon: Melee DPS with Sap, Kick and stuns. Let the tank establish threat and avoid cleave zones.
rogue.pvp: Pick favorable openings, track escape cooldowns and use racial anti-control tools to preserve initiative.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.path: Enhancement-style solo leveling with caster and healer flexibility
shaman.roles: Melee or ranged DPS · healer; tanking depends on Forever support
shaman.early: Complete totem and class quests as offered, especially for the new Dwarf combination. Keep weapon skills and mana recovery supplies current.
shaman.mid: Choose totems for the actual fight rather than dropping every option. Enhancement can reduce drinking; keep an Intellect and healing set.
shaman.late: Verify Forever talent, weapon and tanking changes before committing. Purge, interrupts, cleansing and emergency healing remain valuable.
pull: Place only totems that repay their mana and travel time.
Open at range when it improves positioning, then use the chosen weapon or spell plan.
Interrupt or purge high-value enemy effects.
Recover totems and mana before relocating where current mechanics allow.
shaman.gear: Weapon damage supports Enhancement; Intellect, spell or healing power and mana support caster or healing roles. Keep role sets distinct.
shaman.dungeon: State your role clearly. Heal with a set; DPS with controlled totem placement. Tank only if current Forever tools and the group support it.
shaman.pvp: Use Stoneform against physical debuffs, protect mana for shocks and heals, and do not leave useful totems behind your retreat line.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.early: Complete demon quests, keep a wand current and use Life Tap only when your health buffer is safe. Carry enough Soul Shards without filling every bag.
warlock.mid: Let damage-over-time effects and the pet work while you move. Drain or wand finishes can reduce downtime; manage threat between pet and caster.
warlock.late: Choose a demon for the situation and preserve banish, fear, curses and healthstone utility. Verify Forever talent and shard changes.
pull: Send the demon and establish control.
Apply effects that will complete enough of their duration.
Convert health and mana only when the next incoming damage is safe.
Drain, wand or move toward the next pull as the target finishes.
warlock.gear: Spell damage, Intellect and Stamina support damage and Life Tap; a strong early wand still saves mana.
warlock.dungeon: Ranged DPS with summons, healthstones, banish and situation-specific curses. Fear only with a safe path.
warlock.pvp: Maintain pet control, create space before fearing, and protect enough health to use Life Tap safely.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.early: A weapon upgrade can matter more than several armor pieces. Carry food, train weapon skills and use ranged pulls to separate enemies.
warrior.mid: Pool rage across safe pulls when possible. Learn stance and interrupt tools; keep a shield and one-hander if you may tank.
warrior.late: Plan around strong weapon milestones and verify Forever talent changes. Use defensive cooldowns before low health makes them irrelevant.
pull: Use a ranged pull when it prevents adds.
Build rage and spend it on abilities that shorten the fight without starving the next one.
Interrupt dangerous casts and disarm suitable enemies.
Bandage or eat before the next risky pull.
warrior.gear: Weapon damage is the first solo priority; Strength, Agility or critical chance and Stamina follow. Keep a shield and tank pieces.
warrior.dungeon: DPS or tank. If tanking, mark targets, use line-of-sight and set the pace around healer mana.
warrior.pvp: Keep an escape or control response for roots and kiting; racials can change how you reconnect.

stages.title: Northshire: a compact first loop
stages.goal: Finish the starting pocket before moving to Goldshire.
steps: Use the named pickup list below. Clear the Northshire Abbey and vineyard cluster before the Echo Ridge and Garrick loop.
Group for crowded named targets when credit can be shared. Avoid waiting through several respawns alone.
Loot vendor items, sell on a turn-in trip and train useful available spells.
Leave for Goldshire when the local quest pocket is exhausted, around level 6.
stages.priest: Begin with your available direct damage. Heal between pulls and avoid spending mana on damage that will land after the target is effectively dead.
stages.pvp: Stay on the compact route. Launch congestion is the main reason to group here.
stages.exit: Move to Elwynn at roughly 6; do not chase every distant objective.
stages.alt: If one objective is overcrowded, do another nearby quest and loop back.

stages.title: Shadowglen: establish your rhythm
stages.goal: Reach Dolanaar with supplies and your core spells trained.
steps: Use the named pickup list below. Clear the Aldrassil grove cluster before entering Webwood cave with both cave quests.
Join a small group for crowded cave or named-enemy objectives; agree on the exit.
Sell and train during turn-in trips instead of returning after each quest.
Move to Dolanaar around level 6 once the starter pocket is complete.
stages.priest: Practice ranged pulls and mana-efficient finishes. Keep emergency healing on a comfortable key.
stages.pvp: Avoid getting trapped deep in a crowded cave while competing for tags.
stages.exit: Continue through Teldrassil, but leave the island early enough for Hall at 15.
stages.alt: Skip a stalled spawn temporarily; finish an outdoor loop.

stages.title: Elwynn: prepare the Ironforge transfer
stages.goal: Reach 10–11 with current class training and a useful weapon, then travel north instead of settling into Westfall.
steps: Take the named Goldshire quests below, then clear Fargodeep and the two farms before the Jasperlode / Eastvale circuit.
Group for Hogger or similarly difficult objectives if a group is already available.
Visit your class trainer, sell, restock class resources and check for a useful weapon upgrade.
Travel to Stormwind, learn its flight path, then take the Deeprun Tram to Ironforge.
Arrive near level 11–12 and begin the Dun Morogh dungeon preparation.
stages.priest: A good early wand can reduce drinking. Keep money for spells; do not overpay for minor armor upgrades.
stages.pvp: Avoid detouring into higher-level zones for one reward before the fixed dungeon milestone.
stages.exit: Be in the Ironforge area before 14, ideally 11–12.
stages.alt: Use easy Dun Morogh or Loch Modan objectives after transferring if you need experience.

stages.title: Teldrassil: leave room for the journey
stages.goal: Transfer to Ironforge around 11–12; do not stay in Darkshore until 20.
steps: Use the named Dolanaar pickup list below; finish the Lake Al’Ameth and Ban’ethil clusters without adding a long island cleanup tour.
Visit Darnassus for training and supplies, and collect the relevant flight path.
Head through Rut’theran to the mainland. Confirm the launch boat destination before boarding.
If the boat goes to Stormwind, use the tram to Ironforge. If using Menethil, the Wetlands–Loch Modan road is dangerous at this level: travel with help.
Collect flight paths on the chosen route and start Dun Morogh preparation before level 14.
stages.priest: Carry water and a usable wand before leaving. Train available survival tools before the long transfer.
stages.pvp: Do not use a high-level overland shortcut without help. Boat routes must be verified in the launch client.
stages.exit: Reach Ironforge around 12–13 so preparation fits before the level-15 run.
stages.alt: Prefer the safe boat/tram route if available; ask for an escort when the route requires Wetlands.

stages.title: Coldridge: clear the starting pocket
stages.goal: Finish the compact starter quests and reach greater Dun Morogh efficiently.
steps: Use the named Anvilmar pickup list below; clear the boar fields before carrying both Grelin quests into the Frostmane cave.
Train class abilities and sell during turn-ins instead of making extra trips.
Group for crowded named targets when shared credit makes it faster.
Leave the valley around level 6 with supplies and free bag space.
stages.pvp: Launch congestion matters more than enemy players in the protected starter pocket.
stages.exit: Move toward Kharanos around level 6.
stages.alt: Rotate to another nearby objective when a spawn is saturated.

stages.title: Dun Morogh: level toward the Hall preparation
stages.goal: Use local loops and arrive in Ironforge with time for the Hall chain.
steps: Use the named Kharanos pickups below; clear the Grizzled Den, Gol’Bolar and Amberstill clusters as separate short loops.
Visit the class trainer and keep your primary weapon, ranged weapon or spell ranks current.
Collect the Ironforge flight path and set up bags, repairs and supplies.
Finish productive eastern Dun Morogh quests until roughly level 11.
Begin the Hall preparation route early rather than clearing every remaining quest.
stages.pvp: Stay near roads when moving between camps and Ironforge.
stages.exit: Begin the shared Hall preparation around 11–12.
stages.alt: Use suitable Loch Modan quests only if local objectives are blocked.

stages.title: Coldridge: begin the Gnome route
stages.goal: Complete the starter pocket, train, and move into Dun Morogh.
steps: Use the named Anvilmar pickup list below; clear the boar fields before carrying both Grelin quests into the Frostmane cave.
Sell vendor loot and train during the same visit.
Group for crowded caves and named enemies rather than waiting alone.
Leave around level 6 with enough space for the Dun Morogh loops.
stages.pvp: Avoid getting pinned inside a crowded cave; keep an exit path.
stages.exit: Move toward Kharanos around level 6.
stages.alt: Switch objectives when launch traffic stalls progress.

stages.title: Dun Morogh: build toward Ironforge
stages.goal: Level close to home and prepare the fixed Hall milestone.
steps: Use the named Kharanos pickups below; clear the Grizzled Den, Gol’Bolar and Amberstill clusters as separate short loops.
Train class abilities and maintain the weapon or spell tool your class actually uses.
Visit Ironforge for flight access, bags and profession choices.
Use eastern Dun Morogh quests to reach roughly level 11.
Start the Hall preparation before optional cleanup can push you past the target.
stages.pvp: Keep your return path clear around caves and trogg camps.
stages.exit: Begin the shared Hall preparation around 11–12.
stages.alt: Use nearby Loch Modan quests if a Dun Morogh objective is overcrowded.

stages.title: Zephras Isle: learn the Skyborne start
stages.goal: Follow the Alliance High Order story while learning your class tools.
steps: Use the live-name capture list below at each Zephras Isle hub; record exact Forever quest and NPC names when the launch client exposes them.
Use Walk on Air and other racial tools deliberately; verify their launch behavior in the client.
Train class abilities and keep bag space for the new-zone quest items.
Group for congested named targets and record any launch-only prerequisites.
stages.pvp: Treat route and transport details as launch-sensitive; use the safe story path.
stages.exit: Advance through the island story around level 6.
stages.alt: Stay on verified quest hubs rather than attempting an undocumented shortcut.

stages.title: Zephras Isle: finish and transfer
stages.hub: High Order quest hubs → Alliance mainland
stages.goal: Complete the starting experience and reach Ironforge before the Hall deadline.
steps: Use the Zephras Isle story-hub placeholders below and replace them with exact live quest names through the update prompt.
Learn the island flight or transfer points as the launch client presents them.
Finish essential class training and supplies before leaving.
Use the verified Alliance transfer, then route to Ironforge.
Arrive around 12–13 and immediately begin the Hall preparation chain.
stages.pvp: Do not assume beta transport destinations; follow the live-client Alliance transfer.
stages.exit: Reach Dun Morogh / Ironforge by roughly 12–13.
stages.alt: If the transfer differs at launch, use the update prompt and preserve the Hall-by-15 priority.

stages.title: Dun Morogh: assemble the Hall quest log
stages.goal: Finish the outside chain before your level-15 run.
steps: Pick up A Visitor to Dun Morogh from Beldin Steelgrill if available; follow the Farsen quest line.
Work through Farsen’s Watch and Nip ’Em in the Bud as offered. Loot the Dark Iron Map from the relevant Dark Iron enemies.
Use the map to start Underground Map; turn it in and obtain Old Ironforge Incursion when eligible.
Collect Important Heirlooms and The Restless Dead in the Old Ironforge entrance area when available.
Begin forming your Hall group at level 14. Stop optional questing if it risks pushing you beyond 15 before entry.
stages.priest: Arrive with current training, supplies and role-appropriate gear. State your dungeon role before the first pull.
stages.pvp: Preparation is close to Alliance hubs. Finish supplies here before traveling north later.
stages.exit: Enter Hall of Thanes at level 15; quest gates are launch-dependent.
stages.alt: Use nearby easy quests to reach 15, not a new zone circuit.

stages.title: Hall of Thanes: your first fixed stop
stages.goal: First entry no later than level 15. Complete all eligible quests.
steps: Enter at 15 with your three outside quest pickups ready.
Tell the party you want all quest objectives and both inside pickups.
After the first boss, check the Ghostly Attendant for An Ancient Grudge.
Inspect the treaty tablet in the vault. If level-gated, record the missing quest for a return.
Turn in finished quests, inspect every class-appropriate reward, and prepare the next stage.
stages.priest: Focus the tank’s target; conserve mana on short-lived enemies. Use utility rather than spreading damage onto uncontrolled packs.
stages.pvp: Take advantage of this city visit for bags, training, repairs and water.
stages.exit: Turn in available Hall quests before heading into your next questing block.
stages.alt: If no group is available at 15, work on group formation and supplies rather than silently leveling past your deadline.

stages.title: Westfall: prepare Deadmines before the northern trip
stages.goal: Gain levels and advance Defias prerequisites without running Deadmines yet.
steps: Return through Stormwind. Collect the three Deadmines pickups from Wilder Thistlenettle and Shoni the Shilent.
At Sentinel Hill, begin Gryan Stoutmantle’s Defias Brotherhood chain.
Combine its local objectives with nearby Westfall quests. Complete the Redridge/Stormwind travel legs in a single circuit when offered.
Finish the messenger and escort steps as the chain requires, then collect the dungeon finale and Red Silk Bandanas.
Set your hearthstone to Stormwind before the northern dungeon journey. Assemble the group before traveling.
stages.priest: Keep Deepblaze or a comparable wand equipped. Use spell damage to soften enemies and wand to preserve mana.
stages.pvp: Keep the northern transfer as a group journey. Do not walk into hostile territory merely to look for a group.
stages.exit: Head for Ruins at roughly 17–18; unfinished Defias preparation can be completed afterward.
stages.alt: Use Loch Modan quests if Westfall is too congested, but preserve the dungeon order.

stages.title: Ruins of Lordaeron: travel together, loot carefully
stages.goal: Complete the four documented Alliance quest pickups inside.
steps: Confirm your party and travel route before leaving; collect useful Alliance flight paths en route.
Use the overland approach through Hillsbrad/Silverpine only with awareness of higher-level enemies and Horde traffic. Avoid hostile towns and guards.
Inside, accept Abominable Creatures from Captain Truman before The Baron.
Loot skeletons for Bloodied Insignia and start it immediately; inspect the graveyard letter and crest spawn points.
Check objectives before leaving, then hearth to Stormwind. Turn in the crest and retain the letter chain for the Duskwood visit.
stages.priest: Level 18 is the comfortable target if healing. Keep mana for recovery between pulls; do not depend on killing blows in a group.
stages.pvp: This is your highest-risk early travel leg. Depart together and avoid fighting near Horde guards.
stages.exit: Return south before Deadmines; do not swap the order because a group happens to be available.
stages.alt: If the approach is camped, finish southern prerequisites and retry with the same planned dungeon order.

stages.title: Deadmines: finish the whole quest package
stages.goal: Complete the prepared quest package in one clear; this is not assumed to provide two full levels.
steps: Finish the Defias chain if needed. Verify the final Defias quest and Red Silk Bandanas are in your log.
Check all three Stormwind pickups before traveling to Moonbrook.
With the group, clear the outside undead section for Collecting Memories and Oh Brother… before entering.
Complete Underground Assault, bandanas and the VanCleef objective inside.
Loot The Unsent Letter from VanCleef. Complete turn-ins and keep its follow-up chain for the later Stockades visit.
stages.priest: Do not replace a better wand solely because an item is blue. Compare actual bonuses and keep suitable healing gear.
stages.pvp: Assemble before entering the mines; avoid a long solo corpse run through respawns.
stages.exit: Move into Redridge after the turn-ins, usually around level 20. Do not repeat Deadmines solely to force level 21.
stages.alt: If one clear leaves you below level 20, bridge with close Westfall or western Redridge quests.

stages.title: Redridge: work outward from Lakeshire
stages.goal: Complete manageable road, shoreline and nearby camp loops.
steps: Learn the Lakeshire flight path, sell and gather level-appropriate town quests.
Batch lakeside and western-road objectives before taking a second trip east.
Group for elite or densely packed camps when a group is readily available.
Skip orange objectives and long chains blocked by difficulty; move to Duskwood instead.
Keep any dungeon-related breadcrumbs and return to the hub before crossing zones.
stages.priest: Short controlled pulls beat recovering from crowded camps. Save Psychic Scream for clear ground.
stages.pvp: Contested roads and town approaches can be busy. Leave a camp after repeated targeted deaths.
stages.exit: Move to Duskwood around 23–24 or earlier if only difficult quests remain.
stages.alt: Early Duskwood or suitable remaining Loch Modan quests.

stages.title: Duskwood: split Darkshire and Raven Hill loops
stages.goal: Finish useful local chains and your Lordaeron letter follow-up.
steps: Take the Darkshire flight path and inspect the Remember That I Love You follow-up destination.
Combine eastern forest objectives first; hand in before the long western circuit.
Batch Raven Hill and cemetery objectives together, keeping an open retreat path.
Group for Mor’ladim or other difficult finales; check the current class-appropriate reward rather than an old item list.
Collect Stockades pickups now; run after the Wetlands prerequisite circuit.
stages.priest: Undead control can be useful when available. Use it deliberately and keep DoTs off a controlled enemy.
stages.pvp: Do not sit low on mana along a busy road or deep in the cemetery.
stages.exit: Move to Wetlands around 26–27 when local quests become travel-heavy.
stages.alt: Wetlands, or remaining Redridge quests now within your level.

stages.title: Wetlands: connect the northern quest hubs
stages.goal: Complete the Wetlands dungeon preparation and the required excavation run.
steps: Take the named Menethil Harbor pickups below before starting the coast, excavation and Dun Modr circuits.
Combine coastline and nearby marsh objectives in one loop; return before moving inland.
Batch excavation and inland objectives together rather than commuting repeatedly.
Keep Dun Modr-related prerequisites in mind for a later complete Stockades quest run.
Complete Excavation Site at 27–29; follow the required dungeon circuit above.
stages.priest: Be careful with underwater objectives: pull conservatively and surface before committing to another enemy.
stages.pvp: Retreat toward a clear road, not into additional marsh enemies.
stages.exit: Around 30, choose northern Stranglethorn or Arathi based on available quests and pressure.
stages.alt: Finish Duskwood chains or take one prepared dungeon run.

stages.title: Northern Stranglethorn: overlap your objectives
stages.goal: Make compact hunting loops; do not force the entire zone in one visit.
steps: Collect suitable expedition and Alliance objectives before starting a hunting loop.
Combine nearby targets by area, returning when several tasks are complete.
Hold harder chain stages for a later visit rather than grinding higher-level enemies.
Keep a route back to safety and travel to distant turn-ins only when several align.
Complete City of Dalaran at 31–33 after the Gnomeregan preparation block.
stages.priest: DoTs are useful on enemies that survive enough ticks. Avoid mana-heavy multi-pulls in contested hunting areas.
stages.pvp: This bracket can be volatile. Two deaths to the same group is the signal to switch areas.
stages.exit: Move to Arathi around 33, or sooner when contested objectives stall.
stages.alt: Arathi; remaining Wetlands quests; a prepared Scarlet Monastery run.

stages.title: Arathi: one Refuge Pointe circuit at a time
stages.goal: Complete appropriate open-world quests and skip blocked elite pockets.
steps: Learn the flight path and collect level-appropriate Alliance objectives.
Work through one side of the zone per circuit, combining nearby kill and collection tasks.
Attempt elite areas only with a group; do not let one chain consume the whole session.
Prepare the four-wing Scarlet Monastery visit and the Desolace prerequisite chain.
Compare available local quests with Desolace or a return to Stranglethorn.
stages.priest: Keep enough mana for an unexpected player encounter after a mob dies.
stages.pvp: Avoid contested choke points when the same opposing group controls them.
stages.exit: At 35–36, choose the quieter of Stranglethorn, Desolace or suitable Riverglades hubs.
stages.alt: Desolace or Riverglades, with new content only if it fits your route.

stages.title: Mid-30s: choose the productive circuit
stages.hub: Nijel’s Point or your existing Stranglethorn hub
stages.goal: Visit Desolace for Monastery prerequisites, with suitable quest loops as filler.
steps: Use productive Stranglethorn chains as filler; preserve the required Desolace prerequisite trip.
If relocating, collect Nijel’s Point flight access and batch local Desolace objectives.
Avoid committing to every reputation or distant collection chain just to clear the log.
Riverglades can replace this bracket if nearby quests prove dense and suitable.
Complete Drowned City around 38–40 and all four Scarlet Monastery wings in the planned circuit.
stages.priest: Revisit training and wand strength when kills slow down. Save gold for upcoming travel improvements.
stages.pvp: A quieter zone can beat an optimal quest route interrupted by corpse runs.
stages.exit: Move into the 40–45 circuit when suitable quests thin out.
stages.alt: Arathi cleanup or optional Riverglades. Do not add every option to the same route.

stages.title: Badlands: a short, focused visit
stages.hub: Accessible quest camps / nearby Alliance flight connection
stages.goal: Use suitable quest clusters, then leave before travel dominates.
steps: Train and review your next class talent milestone before committing to another long loop.
Collect appropriate camp quests and combine shared creature areas.
Check the route back to an Alliance flight point before setting out; do not assume a local Alliance hub.
Prepare the required Uldaman full clear around 45–47.
Keep Riverglades or Tanaris as alternatives rather than forcing sparse quests.
stages.priest: Review Shadowform timing against your actual talent points. Respec only for a clear improvement; verify launch costs.
stages.pvp: Open terrain helps you see approaching players. Avoid low-mana fights near active enemy groups.
stages.exit: Move to Tanaris around 43 or when local loops stop paying off.
stages.alt: Riverglades; early Feralas quests that match your level.

stages.title: Tanaris: Gadgetzan-centered loops
stages.goal: Combine desert objectives and begin Zul’Farrak preparation.
steps: Learn the flight path and set a convenient hearth if you will remain in this region.
Gather level-appropriate Gadgetzan quests and complete nearby objectives together.
Do coastal or pirate objectives as a separate prepared loop rather than repeated cross-zone trips.
Gather Zul’Farrak prerequisites before arranging a run around 47–49.
Leave harder or remote chains for later if Feralas offers cleaner progress.
stages.priest: Carry sufficient water for long loops. Do not turn a crowded camp into a multi-target mana test.
stages.pvp: Do not assume a neutral town prevents PvP trouble outside its guarded area.
stages.exit: Move to the Feralas / Zul’Farrak circuit around 47; the dungeon is required.
stages.alt: Feralas or Hinterlands if the desert is heavily contested.

stages.title: Feralas: finish a loop before the next crossing
stages.goal: Minimize repeated travel between island and mainland objectives.
steps: Establish flight and transport access before a long quest circuit.
Collect compatible objectives and batch mainland work before returning to Feathermoon.
Group for difficult finales when a party is already forming.
Use Hinterlands as the alternate circuit if you have stronger chains waiting there.
Prepare the full Maraudon route at 50–52, including both colored sections.
stages.priest: Maintain a small healing set without filling all bag slots. Sell between major circuits.
stages.pvp: Trees and uneven terrain obscure players and additional enemies; keep your exit visible.
stages.exit: Move toward Un’Goro around 50–51, completing only useful remaining chains.
stages.alt: Hinterlands or remaining Tanaris objectives.

stages.title: Un’Goro: stack collection objectives
stages.goal: Carry a broad quest log and finish overlapping crater objectives.
steps: Learn the refuge flight path and collect appropriate quests before beginning a circuit.
Combine creature and collection objectives by sector; keep free bag space.
Avoid roaming elite enemies and do not fight with your back toward an unseen patrol.
Return with several completed objectives rather than after every collection task.
Complete Alcaz Prison around 51–53; verify access and fill its quest placeholders.
stages.priest: Steady single-target kills are the default. Use defensive cooldowns early enough to create an escape.
stages.pvp: Watch both enemy players and roaming elites; either can punish a low-mana pull.
stages.exit: Move to Felwood near 53 when remaining tasks become scattered or difficult.
stages.alt: Finish Feralas/Hinterlands chains or start suitable Felwood quests.

stages.title: Felwood: keep travel and danger manageable
stages.goal: Complete suitable hub loops and prepare the northern transition.
steps: Collect flight access and nearby quests as you progress along the zone.
Batch adjacent objectives; avoid repeated full-length road trips.
Inspect any access or reputation requirements before assuming a passage to the next zone is safe.
Complete Sunken Temple around 54–55 after its prerequisite chains are ready.
Choose Western Plaguelands or Winterspring next based on your accessible hubs and level.
stages.priest: Camps can be dense. Pull to cleared ground and keep fear away from fresh packs.
stages.pvp: Roads and narrow transitions can be camped. Scout before committing.
stages.exit: At 55, move into the final hub circuit rather than grinding awkward leftovers.
stages.alt: Remaining Un’Goro objectives or early Western Plaguelands.

stages.title: Western Plaguelands: cautious hub progression
stages.goal: Gain levels through suitable open-world chains and scoped dungeon trips.
steps: Establish Chillwind flight access and gather appropriate quests.
Complete nearby chains in batches; isolate enemies near buildings and fences.
Group for elites and avoid pulling through uncleared interiors.
If running Blackrock Depths, agree on the exact boss route and quest objectives before joining.
Move to Winterspring or Eastern Plaguelands when the next quests fit your level better.
stages.priest: Keep undead control available where applicable. Refresh useful healing gear if volunteering for a longer dungeon.
stages.pvp: Leave mana and a retreat line on every pull; high-level players may pass through.
stages.exit: Around 58, prioritize finishing good chains and preparing the required final dungeon circuits.
stages.alt: Winterspring or remaining Felwood quests.

stages.title: The last stretch: finish strong chains
stages.goal: Reach 60 without turning the last levels into premature gear farming.
steps: Choose the zone where you already have the most useful chain progress and flight access.
Complete suitable hub loops; take elite quests only with a ready group.
Complete Blackmaw Hold around 58–60; fill its Alliance quest placeholders before departure.
Leave Shaper’s Terrace for 60 unless a suitable group and verified tuning support an earlier visit.
At 60, review talents, training and gearing for your intended activities. Export your finished progress.
stages.priest: Upgrade when an item is a real improvement. Save repeated loot farming for after the leveling objective is complete.
stages.pvp: Relocate between the two final hubs if one is persistently blocked.
stages.exit: Level 60 reached. Continue the required dungeon completion blocks below.
stages.alt: Finish Western Plaguelands/Felwood chains or one prepared dungeon.

stages.title: Level 60: Dire Maul circuit and Shaper’s Terrace
stages.goal: Finish East, North tribute, West and the North return; place Shaper’s Terrace by verified geography.
steps: Collect Feathermoon and Moonglade pickups; complete Dire Maul East for access.
Run North tribute; prepare Unfinished Gordok Business before West.
Clear West and the library, then return North for the linked turn-in.
Confirm Shaper’s Terrace entrance, quests and tuning; complete the required run.
stages.priest: Bring dispels, water and an agreed role. Do not DoT targets the group needs to control.
stages.pvp: Travel to entrances as a group.
stages.exit: Proceed to the Blackrock block once these runs are recorded.
stages.alt: Swap whole level-60 continent blocks when group availability makes that more efficient.

stages.title: Level 60: upper BRD and both Spires
stages.hub: Morgan’s Vigil → Flame Crest → Blackrock Mountain
stages.goal: Finish BRD chains, Lower Spire and Upper Spire with planned turn-ins between runs.
steps: Finish BRD prison turn-ins and collect bar/vault/Emperor objectives.
Run upper BRD; arrange the Windsor escort and outside-material returns as needed.
Complete LBRS and turn in Bijou / Drakkisath preparation; return for Maxwell if necessary.
Arrange UBRS access and group size; collect conditional attunement objectives before the run.
stages.priest: Clarify DPS versus healing before departure. Utility and safe mana management matter more than padding damage.
stages.pvp: Avoid solo entrance travel during active fighting.
stages.exit: Move to the Plaguelands chain circuit.
stages.alt: Do the Plaguelands first if no upper-spire group is available; keep the Blackrock checklist pending.

stages.title: Level 60: linked Plaguelands quest clears
stages.goal: Complete Scholo and both Stratholme routes, including their gated returns.
steps: Collect WPL/EPL quests and prepare Dawn’s Gambit / Of Love and Family. Arrange Scholomance entrance access.
Do initial Scholo objectives; turn in Eva’s chain between the Bag and Kirtonos visits.
Do Stratholme live Archivist and undead Flesh samples; turn in before their follow-up clears.
Unlock Ras preparation after Eva; collect Menethil’s Gift before the next undead visit.
Repeat live for Balnazzar’s head, turn in, then undead for Above and Beyond / Active Agent / Menethil as ready.
Return to Scholomance for the final Ras objective. Review unresolved placeholders and export progress.
stages.priest: Use Shackle on agreed targets; avoid damaging controlled undead. Carry enough water for longer clears.
stages.pvp: Group before approaching the instance gates.
stages.exit: Every requested dungeon is covered; unresolved or conditional quests remain clearly recorded.
stages.alt: A repeat run is for an actual gated quest, not mandatory loot farming.

brd-upper-q5.note: The Emperor quest follows the Kharan/Magni turn-in sequence. Omitted unless fully unlocked before the single BRD clear.

dm-north-q2.note: Starts after a North tribute clear, sends you into West, then requires a North return. Omitted from the one-clear-per-wing route.

dm-west-q3.note: Conditional repeatables: bring materials and complete at most one relevant libram turn-in; do not farm or repeat the wing.

lbrs-q2.note: Maxwell’s Mission unlocks after Bijou’s report and would require another LBRS boss clear. Omitted from the one-clear route.

lbrs-q8.note: Collect Seal of Ascension components during the one LBRS clear. The external forging and return are not allowed to trigger another clear.

scholo-q2.note: Unlocks only after Plagued Hatchlings is turned in outside. Omitted from the single Scholomance clear.

scholo-q4.note: Unlocks after the first Eva dungeon objective is turned in. Omitted from the single Scholomance clear.

scholo-q5.note: Later Eva chain stage that normally needs another Scholomance entry. Omitted from the one-clear route.

scholo-q7.note: Final Ras objective unlocks after linked Scholomance and Stratholme stages. Omitted because no Scholomance return is allowed.

strat-live-q6.note: Balnazzar’s head quest unlocks only after The Archivist is turned in. Omitted because the full Stratholme clear happens once.

strat-undead-q1.note: The Active Agent unlocks after The Flesh Does Not Lie is turned in. Omitted because no second Stratholme entry is allowed.

strat-undead-q2.note: Above and Beyond depends on the excluded Balnazzar-head follow-up. Omitted from the one-clear route.

strat-undead-q3.note: Include only if the complete Ras/Menethil chain is prepared before the single Stratholme clear; otherwise omit it.

ubrs-q2.note: Use the corrected Finkle Einhorn quest title; complete it during the single UBRS clear.

ubrs-q6.note: Drakefire Amulet progression normally sends you back through BRD. Omitted from the one-clear route unless the entire chain is already prepared before the single UBRS clear.
